title: European Commission — Food Additives Database
use: Official EU E-number and additive-name reference; it does not by itself establish vegan suitability.

title: European Commission — Food Additive E306 detail
use: Official EU record for the identity and designation of antioxidant E306; it does not establish a vegan origin for a particular formulation.

title: Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 — specifications for food additives
use: Official EU specifications reference for authorised food additives; it does not certify the source of a commercial ingredient.

title: European Commission — Re-evaluation of food additives
use: Official EU overview of the additive re-evaluation programme; it does not establish vegan suitability.

title: The Vegan Society
use: Reference for the vegan definition and obvious animal-derived ingredient families.

title: Vegetarian Society — Trademark Criteria
use: Reference for vegetarian ingredient boundaries; certification also has production requirements that a label cannot establish.

title: Consorzio Tutela Grana Padano — Ingredients
use: Official source stating that Grana Padano PDO uses rennet extracted from the calf's stomach.

title: Open Food Facts API documentation
use: Vocabulary and future product-label test cases only. No Open Food Facts dataset is imported in this repository.

title: WebAdditifs — Additifs végétalien ou non
use: Research lead only. Its content is not copied or redistributed; every proposed status needs independent review.

title: Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 — specifications for food additives
role: Primary legal specifications used only where the additive definition directly establishes an animal, plant or elemental identity.
limitations: A specification identifies an additive; it is not a general vegan certification and does not resolve origin-variable additives.
use: Evidence for E901 beeswax, E902 candelilla wax, E903 carnauba wax, E966 lactitol, E1105 lysozyme and the elemental gases E938, E941 and E948.

title: Fédération végane — Liste des additifs alimentaires (E)
role: Specialist vegan guidance used to corroborate directly documented animal-origin cases and to identify origin-variable cases requiring caution.
limitations: Non-regulatory overview; it is not exhaustive and does not establish a manufacturer-specific origin or vegan certification.
use: Corroboration for the E966 and E1105 decisions; research guidance for the uncertain candidate review.

title: Vegan Easy — Food additives
role: Specialist vegan guidance that records known animal sources and manufacturer-dependent alternatives.
limitations: Non-regulatory consumer guidance; a listed general origin cannot resolve an individual product without an explicit qualifier.
use: Corroboration for the E966 and E1105 decisions; evidence to retain origin-variable candidates as UNCERTAIN.

title: Les Additifs Alimentaires — Liste de tous les additifs végétariens
role: Secondary specialist comparison source used only to detect agreement or disagreement during the audit.
limitations: Secondary, undated consumer material; it is never sufficient by itself for a global classification.
use: Cross-check only for the 0.6.11.1 audit; no status is based solely on this source.

title: Council Directive 2001/110/EC — relating to honey
role: Primary local regulatory source for honey definitions and multilingual product names in Annex I.
limitations: Defines the regulated honey product and names; it does not classify composite products or replace their declared ingredient lists.
use: Evidence for the honey concept and Annex I multilingual aliases.

title: Council Directive 2001/114/EC — relating to certain preserved partly or wholly dehydrated milks for human consumption
role: Primary local regulatory source for preserved partly and wholly dehydrated milk definitions and multilingual product names in Annexes I and II.
limitations: Defines regulated dairy product names and composition only; it does not classify composite products, flavour wording, plant drinks or an individual label beyond its declared ingredients.
use: Evidence for CELEX 02001L0114 multilingual aliases attached to the existing milk and cream concepts.

title: Council Directive 2001/112/EC — fruit juices and certain similar products
role: Primary local source for Annex I fruit juice product names.
limitations: Product definitions do not make fruit nectar vegan: it may contain honey, sugars or sweeteners.

title: Council Directive 2001/113/EC — fruit jams, jellies, marmalades and sweetened chestnut purée
role: Primary local regulatory source for Annex I multilingual names and definitions of jams, jellies, citrus marmalade and sweetened chestnut purée.
limitations: The directive defines regulated categories. It does not classify a product merely marketed with a fruit-related name, nor replace its declared ingredient list when it is outside those definitions.
use: Evidence for the CELEX 02001L0113 aliases and their narrowly defined product concepts.

title: Regulation (EU) No 1308/2013 — common organisation of the markets in agricultural products
institution: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
role: Primary local source for Annex I agricultural sector names and Annex VII product definitions.
limitations: Article 1 excludes fishery and aquaculture products. Regulatory sectors identify agricultural goods but do not establish the composition of a general commercial preparation.

title: Directive 2000/36/EC — cocoa and chocolate products intended for human consumption
institution: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
role: Primary local regulatory source for Annex I cocoa and chocolate sales names and definitions.
limitations: The directive defines categories and does not make generic chocolate or a filled product vegan; recipes and fillings can contain milk or other animal ingredients.
use: Evidence for reviewed CELEX 02000L0036 aliases only; no translation is inferred.
